bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
F="$P/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
test -f "$F"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
BLOB=$(git hash-object "$F")
M1=$(grep -c 'profile_button_smoke' "$F" || true)
M2=$(grep -c 'list_joined_public_channels' "$F" || true)
M3=$(grep -c 'search_button_smoke' "$F" || true)
BODY=$(printf 'SEARCH_TEST_RESIDENT_SOURCE_20261114\nBLOB=%s\nPROFILE_SMOKE=%s\nPUBLIC_VIDEO_ACTION=%s\nSEARCH_SMOKE=%s\nSERVICE_ACTIVE=YES' "$BLOB" "$M1" "$M2" "$M3")
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "$BODY" >/dev/null
echo RESIDENT_SOURCE_CHECK_PASS
